text: grep -n "pending\|wrapper\|chunk_size" src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fread.rs | head -25: itter.instruction("cmp rax, r9"); // is the backend below the wrapper range? 258: // The wrapper fd range ends at the allocated handle capacity, not a 261: emitter.instruction("add r10, r9"); // wrapper range end = USER_WRAPPER_FD_BASE + handle capacity 262: emitter.instruction("cmp rax, r10"); // is the backend above the wrapper range? 263: emitter.instruction("jae __rt_fread_real_fd_x86"); // non-wrapper synthetic backends stay on the native path 268: emitter.instruction("jmp __rt_user_wrapper_fread"); // wrapper backend tail-calls stream_read 288: abi::emit_load_symbol_to_reg(emitter, "r10", "_concat_off", 0); // load the current concat-buffer absolute offset before appending the fread() result 299: emitter.instruction("call __rt_stream_pending_take"); // rax = how many came back 301: emitter.instruction("jz __rt_fread_no_pending_x86"); 307: emitter.label("__rt_fread_no_pending_x86");
